visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a large, ripe strawberry filled with thick white condensed milk. In the background, a white bowl is piled with similarly filled strawberries. The setting is a kitchen with a wooden countertop. (2) Close-up shot: A person uses a small paring knife to carefully cut a square hole into the center of a fresh strawberry. (3) The knife is twisted, and the core of the strawberry is lifted out cleanly. (4) A blue and white tube of condensed milk is squeezed, filling the hollowed-out strawberry with creamy white liquid. (5) A wider shot shows the same process repeated for a whole bowl of strawberries on a wooden table. (6) A man with wavy dark hair, wearing a multi-colored corduroy shirt, holds the white bowl of strawberries, smiling at the camera in a brightly lit kitchen. (7) He is seen talking and gesturing towards the bowl, which now has frozen-looking strawberries. (8) He picks up a strawberry and places it in his mouth. Pink and white heart graphics appear around him. (9) A close-up shows hands cutting a frozen, milk-filled strawberry in half, revealing the icy interior texture. (10) The man continues his enthusiastic review, gesturing with his hands. (11) Final shot of the bowl of prepared strawberries next to a tube of Nestle Eagle brand condensed milk on the wooden surface.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One male creator demonstrated the recipe and performed the tasting.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man in his late 20s with wavy dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt under a color-blocked corduroy shirt (yellow, brown, teal, and beige panels).

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, modern kitchen with a light wooden countertop, white tiled walls, and a teal cabinet visible in the background. Some kitchen utensils and a white ceramic bowl are present.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp 'whoosh' transition leads into high-energy, fast-paced electronic pop music. A male voice speaks enthusiastically with a bright, high-pitched tone. (2) A 'ding' sound effects a step in the tutorial. The narrator explains the process clearly with a quick speech rate. (3) A distinct 'squish' or liquid splash sound as the condensed milk is squeezed. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat rhythm. (4) Another 'ding' and 'whoosh' pair as the scene shifts. The vocal remains very animated, showing high emotional arousal. (5) A crunch or biting sound effect occurs as the creator eats a strawberry. This is followed by a sparkle-like synth sound effect. (6) The music swells slightly towards the end, maintaining a major key, as the narrator gives a final enthusiastic recommendation and a signature vocal sign-off 'Heh~~'.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step-by-step Tutorial -> Review/Tasting -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate how to make a viral strawberry and condensed milk snack while promoting Nestle Eagle brand condensed milk through a high-energy, engaging short-form video.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The Nestle Eagle condensed milk product is prominently displayed, mentioned, and used as the central ingredient throughout the tutorial.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a typical 'social media viral recipe' format, combining quick-cut editing with high-energy narration to maintain viewer interest.
